decision_legend.postgresql_metadata: Small structured records, relations, status, identity, provenance, and queryable summaries.
decision_legend.postgis_optional: Geometry that benefits from relational spatial predicates, joins, extents, or proximity queries.
decision_legend.object_storage: Large, immutable, binary, geospatial, or exportable content addressed by hash.
decision_legend.indexeddb_local_first: Browser draft/cache/offline representation; not the future shared authority.
decision_legend.generated_artifact: Immutable output reference stored in object storage with metadata elsewhere.
decision_legend.not_persisted: Presentation/runtime state that should remain ephemeral.

classifications.reason: Small relational ownership and listing data; local-first browser copy remains useful.
Needs lineage, immutable revisions, fingerprints, dataset references, and run/report relationships.
retain_in_database: resolved input JSON or normalized input rows
classifications.avoid: Full large derived GeoJSON and rays inside the scenario row.

classifications.reason: Reusable inventory ownership, revision lineage, source provenance, and scenario references are relational.

classifications.object: Inventory cell and optional site geometry
classifications.reason: Point geometry and AOI/proximity queries benefit from spatial types; Site remains optional until authoritative grouping exists.
classifications.avoid: Invented site grouping based only on proximity.

classifications.reason: Geometry is small and queryable for clipping/intersection; local copy is required for offline editing.
Version, hashes, license, CRS, bounds, layer status, and availability are queryable metadata.

classifications.object: Buildings and large source geospatial layers
classifications.current_representation: GeoJSON file plus Go in-memory spatial index
classifications.reason: Current building source is about 111 MB with bounded viewport queries; immutable packs and spatial indexes are more efficient than row-per-feature as the default. PostGIS is justified only for product queries/joins that need it.

classifications.current_representation: Optional pack files and runtime paths/cache
classifications.reason: Raster/terrain data is large and is consumed through specialized readers or derived tiles, not ordinary relational rows.
Keep immutable raw CSV/Parquet plus provenance/hash in metadata; queryable sample subsets can be derived later.

classifications.current_representation: API response or in-memory experiment job
classifications.reason: Run status, fingerprints, summaries, lineage, and reproducibility metadata are structured and relational.

classifications.object: Optimization public frontier and selected solutions
classifications.reason: Compact Pareto/public solutions are queryable and selectable; very large explanations/traces can be artifacts.
classifications.avoid: Persisting every internal evaluation by default.

classifications.object: RF rays, received-power samples, coverage surfaces, large GeoJSON
classifications.current_representation: In-memory response, optional scenario cache, or direct download
classifications.reason: Potentially large and immutable per run; store content-addressed files only when requested, retained, or required for audit.
classifications.default: Recompute/cache; persist summary and reference unless user saves/exported evidence.

classifications.reason: Readiness, holdout summaries, assumptions, model results, and sample/data references need durable provenance; large residual layers belong in artifacts.
Definition/lineage is relational; Markdown/PDF/HTML bytes are immutable artifacts.

classifications.object: UI navigation, loading, cancellation, map viewport, explanation cache
classifications.reason: Presentation/runtime state is not planning truth or evidence.

classifications.object: Local draft and offline working copy
classifications.reason: Preserve current single-user/offline experience; add repository and eventual sync metadata later.

database_decision.next_release: Keep IndexedDB; formalize the domain/repository boundary first.
database_decision.postgreSQL: Defer until server sharing, durable remote runs, or multi-user ownership is required.
database_decision.postgis: Optional later for relational geometry queries; not the RF engine and not a requirement for the next phase.
database_decision.object_storage: Introduce conceptually now and implement when durable large artifacts or remote datasets are in scope.
